heading: Openness of meetings
lead: The Administrator by regulation shall require that—

tree.text: formal meetings of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy, as designated by the Administrator, for developing procurement policies and regulations be open to the public; and
public notice of each meeting be given not less than 10 days prior to the meeting.
